An overall view of amino acid catabolism in humans. Different metabolic pathways for the catabolism of amino acids converge to common
intermediates (a-KG, oxaloacetate, and pyruvate) that feed into the Krebs cycle in tissues. Different amino acids have different metabolic fates in the
body. Reproduced from Wu (2013) with permission.
